routine: 복습 3분(영어 가리고 먼저 쓰기) → 가리고 써 보기 2분(빈칸 먼저, 맨 끝 정답 확인) → 새 내용 5분(노트에 옮길 때 짝 표현째로) → 소리 내어 3번 읽기 3분 → 오늘 쓸 표현 1개 골라 실제 메일에 쓰기

items.prompt: (조건상) 해당되는, 자격이 되는: be ____ for — can get 대신

items.answer: I would appreciate it if you could ~.
Please update us as soon as ~.
Just a reminder that ~ is due ~.

items.prompt: 수령, 받음: confirm ____ of ~ — got it 대신
전담의: a ____ team — only for this 대신
우선 처리하다, 먼저 하다 — do first 대신

cover_practice.prompt: 동의: Please get their c______ before you call them.
세부 내역: Please send a b________ of the cost by idea.
붙잡아 두다: Which idea will help us r_____ new sewers after Tet?
부하: Please measure the cabinet temperature under full l___.
지시하다: As i_________ by Mr Moon, the canteen check is now monthly.

words.meaning: (개인정보 사용 등에 대한) 동의 — OK / permission 대신
words.example: We will call the 60 sewers only after we get their consent to use their phone numbers.

words.meaning: 세부 내역, 항목별 분해 — numbers for each 대신
words.example: Please send a cost breakdown for each recruitment idea.
words.collocations: a cost breakdown / a breakdown by idea (by month)

words.meaning: (사람을) 붙잡아 두다, 계속 근무하게 하다 — still working 대신
words.example: We need to know how many new sewers we can retain after Tet.

words.meaning: (전기·기계의) 부하 — while the machines are running 대신
words.example: Please measure the cabinet temperature under full load during working hours.
words.collocations: under full load / at peak load

words.meaning: 지시하다 — It's Mr Moon direction 대신
words.example: As instructed by Mr Moon, please visit the kitchen once a month.

patterns.meaning: ~이고, 그 말은 ~라는 뜻입니다 (and so 대신, 숫자 뒤에 의미를 붙일 때)
patterns.email: The line worked at 86% efficiency, which means it meets the IE standard.

patterns.meaning: ~하기 전에 ~해야 합니다 (only after checking 대신, 먼저 할 일을 못 박을 때)
patterns.email: Before we call them, we need to confirm that we may use their personal data.

patterns.pattern: I'll get back to you on ~.
patterns.meaning: ~은 따로 다시 연락드리겠습니다 (I will review separately 대신, 답을 미룰 때)
patterns.skeleton: I'll get back to you on + [명사] (+ by [날짜])
patterns.email: I'll get back to you on the CM part separately by Friday.
patterns.spoken: Let me get back to you on that.

rewrite.original: Please visit the supplier's kitchen once a month, not once a quarter. It's Mr Moon direction.
rewrite.improved: As instructed by Mr Moon, please visit the supplier's kitchen once a month instead of once a quarter.
rewrite.note: "It's Mr Moon direction"은 소유격('s)과 관사가 빠져 문법이 깨진다. 이유를 뒤에 따로 붙이지 말고 As instructed by Mr Moon으로 문장 앞에 두면 누구 지시인지 먼저 보인다. not once a quarter → instead of once a quarter(10/30 패턴)로 한 문장으로 묶었다. 점검: 주어 (you, 명령문) / 동사 visit / 앞 구절 As instructed by는 절이 아니라 구라 주어·동사 없어도 된다

source: 11/03 보낸 메일(Tho 미싱사 60명 연락·아이디어별 숫자 요청, An 분전반 가동 중 온도 측정, Thao IE 효율 86% 회신, Tho 급식 점검 월 1회 지시, Asanka 항공권), 받은 메일(본사 MES 기계 현황 요청)
